title: RC Filtering for SSM2164 CVs from DACs
summary: Designing the RC filter between an MCP4822 DAC and the control input of an SSM2164/V2164 VCA: scaling the 0–4.1 V DAC range to what the 2164 needs and smoothing DAC steps without making the response sluggish.

sources.title: RC Filtering for SSM2164 CVs fed from DACs
sources.author: Tom Wiltshire (Electric Druid)
